case: A claim may precede its own allocation, so the identity that makes a duplicate external effect detectable is written after the effect.
why: The identity is allocated by C04 BEFORE release; that is what makes it usable for detecting an already-released effect on a retry. With the ordering gone, both timestamps are present and a claim recorded before its allocation is indistinguishable from one recorded after. Coverage note: F6C-16 measured 14 of 30 guards exercised by a paired adverse and benign fixture, and `guard.effect.identity_allocated_before_release` was one of the sixteen without one -- a guard registered with no adverse fixture is a guard nobody has seen fail.
